description: This Java class 'LoanRescheduleRequestTestBuilder' provides methods to build JSON payloads for loan rescheduling requests, including parameters such as reschedule dates, interest rates, and reasons. It is used in integration tests for loan rescheduling functionality within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleRequestTestBuilder
classes.description: Helper class to construct JSON payloads for various loan rescheduling request scenarios used in integration testing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing the loan rescheduling request with specified parameters.

methods.name: updateRescheduleFromDate
methods.description: Updates the reschedule start date parameter.

methods.name: updateGraceOnPrincipal
methods.description: Sets the grace period on principal repayments.

methods.name: updateGraceOnInterest
methods.description: Sets the grace period on interest payments.

methods.name: updateExtraTerms
methods.description: Adds extra terms to the rescheduling request.

methods.name: updateRecalculateInterest
methods.description: Determines whether to recalculate interest during rescheduling.

methods.name: updateNewInterestRate
methods.description: Sets a new interest rate for the rescheduled loan.

methods.name: updateAdjustedDueDate
methods.description: Adjusts the due date for repayment.

methods.name: updateRescheduleReasonId
methods.description: Specifies the reason ID for rescheduling.

methods.name: updateRescheduleReasonComment
methods.description: Adds a comment explaining the reason for rescheduling.

methods.name: updateSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Updates the date the reschedule request was submitted.

methods.name: updateEmiChangeEndDate
methods.description: Updates the end date for EMI changes.

methods.name: getRejectLoanRescheduleRequestJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for rejecting a loan reschedule request.

methods.name: getApproveLoanRescheduleRequestJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for approving a loan reschedule request.
